scope: Independent read-only review of five runtime pins, native flight datum and manual renderer stepping additions; no browser/test execution or source edit.

findings.evidence: walker.teleport stores groundY plus requested relative altitude in eyeY; updateFly clamps eyeY with Math.max(surfaceAt+FLY.minClearance,Math.min(FLY.maxAltitude,eyeY)), then sets altitude=eyeY-groundY and applies camera. Native FLY maxAltitude900 is absolute datum; new checker uses actual served settings, actual groundY/eyeY/altitude/camera and rejects lowered native ceiling/nonfinite/nonflying/mismatches. The held no-input standing→flight scenario keeps bob0; exact camera=eye requirement will fail rather than silently accept a changed path.

At /1904/?device=standard, new URL(../walk/js/travel-settings.js,location.href) resolves /walk/js/travel-settings.js, the native published module. Full mirror/source guards pin this dependency in addition to explicit runtime5 pins.

Positive initial resident count, exact awayresident0, and evictiondelta==initialresident count are required in addition to native flying/absolute clamp. This corrects the prior wrong relative-altitude>=900 assumption without relaxing native caps or real eviction coverage.

setAnimationLoop(null) is called only after actual ready, welcome world and setAnimationHold(true). It stops Three implicit RAF callback; it does not stop window requestAnimationFrame. Original explicit api.step/RAF loops remain byte-exact. Native api.step calls governor.rest,applyGovernor and forced tick. rest sets scale1,pace1,shadowFreshtrue regardless of tier; real tick updates world, camera, residency and confidence renderer. No adaptive stale shadow scale follows from omitting implicit frameDrawn/setTier in this held mode.

Context loss/restore event policy and actual normal page reload remain untouched. Fresh page boots native loop before enterAndHold stops it again. Original independent windowRAF waits/explicit native steps, source/detail transactions, return/readPixels/GLerror/pixel checks, native WEBGLlose+restore/reload, page/request/console errors, source/vendor/mirror guards and actual cleanup remain unchanged.

Focused observer now explicitly records manual execution mode. It cannot establish automatic visitor pacing or watchSteps/blackbox tick behavior, which live in the omitted renderer callback. README explicitly excludes these and retains separate native memory/fullgate qualification. Old FAIL/stopped observers are preserved.
